text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2012.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2012

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi enam ratus empat puluh empat juta

sembilan puluh satu ringgit (RM 644,091,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan

Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2012 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

 Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 143,255,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 131,590,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran-bayaran lain RM 1,264,000

Perbelanjaan lain RM 39,909,000

Hartanah, loji dan peralatan RM 328,073,000

Jumlah RM 644,091,000

Dibuat 23 Februari 2012

[KSM/PUU/T/01/01/01 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)58/XVII]

DATUK SERI DR. SUBRAMANIAM A/L K.V. SATHASIVAM

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2012.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2012

2. A sum not exceeding six hundred and forty four million and ninety one thousand

ringgit (RM 644,091,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security Fund for expenditure

on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the year 2012 as provided in

the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

 Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 143,255,000

Supplies and services RM 131,590,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 1,264,000

Other expenditure RM 39,909,000

Landed property, plant and equipment RM 328,073,000

Total RM 644,091,000

Made 23 February 2012

[KSM/PUU/T/01/01/01 Jld. 2; PN(PU2)58/XVII]

DATUK SERI DR. SUBRAMANIAM A/L K.V. SATHASIVAM

 Minister of Human Resources
